_doc: UNATTENDED-365 (Rowan, 2026-11-20): "The Ultrastable system shall be able to run entirely unattended for 1 year with zero external input and continue to deploy new releases regularly completely on its own code loops." This is the register of every external input the system still has: credentials, renewals, quotas, hosted models, dependencies, outside sessions and the acts only a person's identity can do. status closed = renews or repairs itself, with the probe that proves it; gate = identity-bound (money, sign-in, legal), with the default in effect and one link; open = closable in code, with a queue item. horizon_days is the days until the first non-renewing input lapses. Consumers: foundation/unattended.py (--check inside `openloops --check`; --horizon), foundation/needsyou.py (a closed dependency removes its act from NEEDS-YOU.md), doctrine/rules.json rule no-open-items, tests/foundation/test_unattended.py.

target.statement: Designed to run unattended for a minimum of one year, completely on its own: it keeps its cost down, finds what fails and fixes it, and keeps getting better (Rowan, 2026-11-20).

pillars.statement: It spends nothing a person has to pay for
It finds what fails and fixes it: no clock stays stopped
It gets better by itself: it originates and ships its own deploys

dependencies.what: Second GitHub App for repository settings (archive, main ruleset)
dependencies.evidence: D1 credentials github-admin status ok; events 'all retired repositories archived' 2026-11-17 and 'all rulesets applied' 2026-11-18

dependencies.evidence: runs succeed on 2026-11-20 (executor run 44756043673, loop run 44752694209)

dependencies.evidence: Cloudflare API /accounts/{id}/tokens: 3 active tokens, expires_on null on each, all used on 2026-11-20

dependencies.what: Hosted model ids named in code retire without notice
dependencies.evidence: 2026-11-20: glm-5.3-flash and llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fp8 answered 410 while named in the reviewer ladder and the site; replaced by measured successors

dependencies.what: A sign-in the provider refused was retried every tick forever
dependencies.evidence: 337 Bluesky and 374 Mastodon retries by 2026-11-20; DEAD-CONSENT-1 retries every 6 h and lists the act at /api/v1/owner-acts

dependencies.what: GitHub Actions free minutes per month on private repositories
dependencies.evidence: actions-budget.json pauses non-essential workflows at 85 percent; Worker loops carry merges without minutes (ZERO-MINUTES-1)

dependencies.what: Cloudflare Workers Free daily request, D1 and AI limits
dependencies.evidence: free-tier governor paces loops against the daily limits

dependencies.what: ultrastable.io, .app, .net and .org renew by themselves; they expire 2027-11-10
dependencies.evidence: Cloudflare Registrar API 2026-11-20: auto_renew true on all four (the repository text said off and was wrong)

dependencies.what: ultrastable.net cannot change nameservers while the registrar lock holds
dependencies.evidence: doctrine/open-loops.json gate net-nameserver-switch: 403 code 10000 on 2026-11-19 and 2026-11-20
dependencies.default: zone stays served from the old account; the daily pass retries the approved switch

dependencies.what: Bluesky access was connected on 2026-11-17 and its refresh has been refused since 2026-11-20T01:30Z
dependencies.evidence: D1 credentials oauth:bluesky status failed, last_error 'refresh HTTP 401'
dependencies.default: social posting stays dry-run; registry, feeds and IndexNow keep promoting

dependencies.what: Mastodon app was registered on mstdn.science and the consent never completed
dependencies.evidence: D1 credentials oauth:mastodon status failed, 'no refresh token (consent has not completed)'

dependencies.what: The GitHub organization, the Cloudflare account and the agent subscription all hang off one person's sign-ins
dependencies.evidence: identity anchored to one GitHub login (2026-11-17); a second org owner or account member is an act only that person can take
dependencies.default: the system keeps running on tokens it already renews by itself; nothing new can be connected

dependencies.what: Releases beyond small fixes are written by cloud agent sessions on the owner's paid subscription
dependencies.evidence: criticality row 2026-11-19: self_deploys 0, k_self 0.0, regime driven; a subscription is money and a sign-in
dependencies.default: the Workers AI executor keeps taking queue items on the free plan; a cloud scheduled task (every 6 h, one item per pass, Q-YEAR items first) carries larger releases while the subscription lasts

dependencies.what: The system's own coder must ship releases without any outside session
dependencies.evidence: executor log 2026-11-20: llama-3.3-70b failed an unused-import item 3 times; both reviewer routes were down (GitHub Models non-JSON, glm 410) and the change was approved with the reviewers skipped

dependencies.what: Free GitHub Models route of the author and reviewer ladder
dependencies.evidence: executor log 2026-11-20: 'non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github.ai/inference/chat/completions'

dependencies.what: modelwatch --refresh needs a Workers AI credential on its host; the tick Worker has the AI binding and no credential to mint
dependencies.evidence: modelwatch.refresh reports unmeasured without CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN

dependencies.what: NEEDS-YOU.md was typed by hand and disagreed with live state (3 finished acts listed as open, one false claim of a 3-hourly routine, one stale D1 card)
dependencies.evidence: 2026-11-20: D1 credentials vs foundation/data/needs-you.json; D1 gate card GATE-SECRET-ANTHROPIC_API_KEY says agents stay in dry-run while agents run on Workers AI

dependencies.what: Workflows pin Node 22, which leaves maintenance on 2027-04-30
dependencies.evidence: grep node-version .github/workflows: 10 pins of 22, 1 of 24

dependencies.what: Action versions, npm and pip packages and Worker compatibility dates have no loop that advances them
dependencies.evidence: one wrangler.toml still has compatibility_date 2024-01-01; no updater workflow or Worker step exists

dependencies.what: MAIL_RELAY_TOKEN and MAIL_RELAY_URL on the dashboard Worker carry sign-in codes; their expiry is not measured
dependencies.evidence: Cloudflare API lists the bindings; the relay is on another account and its token lifetime is unread

dependencies.what: Domain renewal (2027-11-10) and any usage above the free plans charge the card on file; a card's expiry is not readable by API
dependencies.evidence: Cloudflare API: subscriptions endpoint answers 403 to the session; one default budget alert exists and mails a person
dependencies.default: every loop stays on the free plans (free-tier governor), so only the yearly domain renewal needs the card

dependencies.what: Workers Logs on every Worker, so the system can read its own failures
dependencies.evidence: Cloudflare API script-settings 2026-11-20: observability enabled on ultrastable-tick, -site, -dashboard, -tenants, -agents and -deploy-gateway; the rendered config sets it on every Worker

dependencies.what: Cloudflare's own alerts (incidents, Worker error rate, usage, certificates) reach no loop: one budget alert exists and it mails a person
dependencies.evidence: Cloudflare API alerting/v3/policies: 1 policy, mechanism email; destinations/webhooks: none

dependencies.what: Every loop starts from Cron Triggers (tick every 10 min, site and dashboard hourly) or GitHub's scheduler; no clock is independent of both
dependencies.evidence: Cloudflare API: one Durable Object namespace (tenants) and no alarm-driven heartbeat; queues 0, workflows 0

dependencies.what: D1 holds the org state with only Cloudflare's own point-in-time restore; the audit chain's R2 sink is not bound on the tick Worker
dependencies.evidence: Cloudflare API: R2 buckets = [ultrastable-git]; ultrastable-tick has no r2_bucket binding; 5 D1 databases, 15.6 MB
